map.中文数字转换工具支持简体、大写与金额格式的中文化与阿拉伯数字双向转换，覆盖万、亿: The Chinese numeral converter supports simplified, uppercase and amount formats in both directions including units such as ten thousand and hundred million, for financial invoicing, receipt filling and document number standardisation.
map.填写「输入（数字或中文字符）」。: Enter "the input (a number or a Chinese character)".
map.填写单据或合同金额前，把数字转成中文大写核对写法。: Before filling in a voucher or contract amount, convert the number into Chinese uppercase wording to check it.
map.读数时 10–19 通常写「十」而不写「一十」，页面遵循中文习惯；票据等特殊场景: When reading numbers 10-19 Chinese convention writes the bare ten rather than one-and-ten, and the page follows that convention; vouchers and similar special cases can be adjusted per institutional rules.
map.连续零读一个“零”，如 10086。: A run of consecutive zeros is read as a single zero, such as in 10086.
map.：12345 → 一万二千三百四十五；10086 → 一万零八十六。: : 12345 becomes twelve thousand three hundred and forty-five in Chinese; 10086 becomes ten thousand and eighty-six.
